verdict.rationale: Ente Auth offers end-to-end encrypted cloud backups "so you don't have to worry about losing your tokens," with codes syncing across mobile, desktop and web. A recovery key gets you back into the account if you are locked out, and password-protected automatic local backups plus CLI backup give additional restore paths. Community comments confirm the free backup service; offline mode is the opt-out exception, where codes stay on the one device. Missing for 10: an explicit step-by-step doc for restoring tokens on a new device after losing the phone, and hands-on or independent confirmation that such a restore works.
